Author: Bunny
Name: BunnyRotationReborn
Description:
Bunny's fork of RotationSolverReborn, tuned for high-end and ultimate content.

Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action: party and enemy status, cooldowns, HP/MP, positions, enemy casts, combos and more. It can highlight the best action on your hotbar or press it for you.

Adds instant use of pressed actions, instant high-end raises, and per-ultimate burst/potion settings for MCH, BRD and DNC. It does not handle mechanics for you. Use it carefully.
Punchline: High-end tuned rotation solver: finds and uses the best action every frame.
